_fixture.why: One member of 433boi's BRANCH SET: the acceptance record with every declared two-branch predicate cell set to the same side of every printed conditional the acceptance record takes. The set carries both sides because a record puts each printed conditional on ONE of them, and because THE ACCEPTANCE RECORD ITSELF IS UNSAFE TO BREAK — other fixtures are generated by reading it off disk, so a break held in it makes them drift from the generator they name and takes the gate down at step 3 on files nobody touched. Neither member of this set is anything else's input.

_business_income_expense_route: OPERATOR INPUT, declared per adapters/pdf/record-shape.mjs. This form prints a route that attaches a profit and loss statement, enters the section total directly and leaves the operand lines EMPTY; the filed page records nowhere which route was taken. "grid" says this record completed the printed lines, and gate step 11 then requires the operands to sum to the total AND at least one of them to be completed. Absent, the gate STOPS - there is no default.

_every_total_is_computed: NOT ONE TOTAL IN THIS FILE IS TYPED. (5a) is the quick-sale value minus the loan balance, and the quick-sale value is the market value times the printed .8. (5) is (5a) plus the attachment line. Box A is the five page-2, page-3 and page-4 totals added. Box B is lines (6) through (10), Box C is (11) through (20), Box D is Box B minus Box C in that printed order. Box E is Box D times 12 and Box F is Box D times 24. The Offer Amount is the Box A copy plus the Box E copy. A total that agrees with a tripwire because the author made it agree proves that the author can add.
_the_two_money_conventions_on_this_form: PAGES 2 AND 3 CARRY CENTS AND PAGES 4 AND 5 DO NOT, and that is deliberate. Every money caption on pages 2, 3 and 4 prints "Round to the nearest dollar", and page 5 prints "Round to the nearest whole dollar" and, beside the Offer Amount, "Use whole dollars only." The map declares no `rounding` block - blanket-audit [K-07] reports the stand-down with its reason on every run - so the tripwires are exact arithmetic and a fixture mixing cents into a whole-dollar sum would fail them for a reason that has nothing to do with the map. So this record keeps slice 2's cents on pages 2 and 3, which makes Box A carry cents, and uses whole dollars from line (6) down. The Box A COPY on page 5 is Box A rounded to the nearest dollar, which the printed whole-dollar instruction requires and which the tripwires permit because that cell is declared not checkable. Carried as [B20].
_what_the_offer_calculation_says_here: Box D is Box B minus Box C, both positive, so the declared floor of 0 is NOT exercised by this record - it is one of the floors the gate reports as unexercised, and a negative fixture would be the instrument that reaches it. The Box E or Box F cell copies BOX E, the five-or-fewer-payments branch. Nothing on the form records that choice, which is why the cell is declared not checkable; the record makes it explicitly so a reader of the filled form knows which branch produced the offer.
_what_this_record_does_not_take: THE INCOME-PRODUCING-ASSET EXCLUSION. The asterisk beside "Enter the amount from Box A" permits excluding equity in income-producing assets other than real estate, and this record excludes nothing - the page-5 copy is the whole of Box A, rounded. A record that DID take the exclusion would write a smaller figure and no tripwire on this form could tell the two apart, which is the finding carried as [B16].
_page_2_is_whole_dollars_because_the_pag: Page 2 draws "Round to the nearest dollar. Do not enter a negative number. If any line item is a negative number, enter \"0\"." at y 670.9, and the map declares that band as the rounding block P2_SECTION_2_CASH_AND_INVESTMENTS. This fixture was authored before that declaration existed and carried cents there; a record filed on that page carries whole dollars, so it does now. Pages 3 and 4 keep their cents deliberately — their bands print NO instruction and are declared none_printed — which is what makes Box A a real rounding-boundary crossing on this fixture rather than a hypothetical one: it sums two whole-dollar operands and three cents operands and rounds its own total, and gate step 11 names the crossing on every run.
_what_is_different_from_the_acceptance_r: NOTHING BUT THIS DECLARATION. Every predicate cell holds the value the acceptance record holds, and every total is the one the acceptance record carries. It exists because the acceptance record cannot be broken without other fixtures drifting from the generators they name, and a line only that side puts in class needs a record of its own to be proved in.
_how_every_total_in_here_was_obtained: CONVERGED AGAINST THE GATE, not typed and not recomputed by a second implementation. scratchpad/author-branch-fixtures.mjs wrote the flipped record, ran adapters/pdf/run-form-gate.mjs against it, read the per-line result the gate writes to adapters/pdf/out/, and copied each failing line's `recomputed` figure — the gate's own sum of the printed operands — back into this file, repeating until no line failed. Every figure here is one the gate computed from the operands this record prints, and the gate re-derives all of them on every run.
_it_names_no_generator_on_purpose: adapters/pdf/validate-map.mjs runs adapters/pdf/assert-fixture-authorship.mjs at GATE STEP 3, and that assert RE-RUNS the generator any fixture names. A `_generated_by` pointing at the script that authored this file would make every gate run spawn a script that spawns the gate. What the generator claim would have carried is written out above instead: the record it came from, the one class of change made to it, and how the figures were obtained.
